question: Why does the scoring system in Knock Balls favor combo attacks?
answer: The scoring system in Knock Balls is designed to reward skillful play, particularly combo attacks. Each consecutive hit in a combo increases your score multiplier, encouraging players to string together attacks rather than relying on single hits. For example, landing a 5-hit combo can double your score compared to five individual hits. This mechanic not only makes the game more engaging but also adds a layer of depth to the gameplay.
